items.name: button-primary
items.title: Primary Button
items.description: The single highest-emphasis action per screen/section. Don't use more than one per view.

items.name: button-secondary
items.title: Secondary Button
items.description: Lower-emphasis action alongside a primary button (e.g. 'Cancel' next to 'Save').

items.name: button-legacy-flat
items.title: Flat Button (legacy)
items.description: Do not use for new work — kept only so existing screens keep rendering until migrated.

items.name: text-field
items.title: Text Field
items.description: Single-line text entry with label, helper text, and error states built in.

items.name: circular-loader
items.title: Circular Loader
items.description: Internal-only building block used inside other components (e.g. button loading state). Not meant to be composed directly in product screens — that's why plain check_coverage misses it; search_components(includeInternal: true) surfaces it.
